name: SvelteKit + shadcn-svelte Template
summary: Full-stack SvelteKit starter with shadcn-svelte, Drizzle + PostgreSQL, better-auth, i18n and an app shell.
description: Production-ready SvelteKit application template with a responsive app shell, better-auth (OAuth + email/password), Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL, dark/light theme switching, internationalization (English/Hebrew), cookie management, SEO components and policy pages. bun scripts scaffold pages, markdown files, database migrations and API controllers.
contains: tech: SvelteKit, shadcn-svelte, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, better-auth, PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM
app shell, theme switching, i18n (English/Hebrew), cookie management
policy pages: privacy, terms, cookies, accessibility statement
bun scripts: create:page, create:md, create:api-controller, db:migrate, tests
roadmap: layout variants, CLI tooling, data table, accessibility tools
